text:
nina: Quick FYI — publishing a docs + SDK notice for PHP SDK caching behavior changes. We're changing the default response cache TTL semantics to be 'request-scoped' instead of 'global' to avoid stale completions for dynamic prompts. Announcing compatibility window and migration guidance today. :memo:

oscar: Will this break existing deployments that rely on global cache across requests?

nina: Short answer: it can for some patterns. Timeline: today we publish the change + a `cache_scope` option (values `global` | `request`) in sdk-php@v1.5.0; for 30 days `global` remains default but emits a deprecation warning; after 30 days `request` becomes default and `global` will be deprecated (180 days removal window).

kelly: Docs owner here. I'll add a migration guide, quickstart update, and a small decision matrix: when to use global vs request. Draft by EOD. Also will surface a small example and a troubleshooting FAQ.

rahul: Engineering notes: we added `ClientConfig::cache_scope = 'request'` option. CI will run integration tests with both scopes for 30 days. We'll also add a runtime warning when `global` is used in production images. For Dedicated/Private, we'll offer a compatibility flag in runtime config for 12 months.

oscar: Example migration snippet for docs?

kelly: Sure:
```php
// legacy (global cache, may serve stale results)
$client = new RedwoodClient(["api_key" => getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), "cache_ttl" => 3600]);

// new (recommended: request-scoped cache)
$client = new RedwoodClient([
  "api_key" => getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"),
  "cache_ttl" => 60,
  "cache_scope" => "request"
]);
```
Notes: request-scope reduces cross-request reuse and is safer for per-session prompts.

nina: Communications plan: blog + immediate support playbook + Dedicated customer email. Support TL;DR: 1) impact is limited to apps relying on global cache; 2) set `cache_scope: global` to keep old behavior for short window; 3) migrate to request scope where prompts vary by user.

kelly: I'll add a banner on the PHP SDK page and a short troubleshooting checklist (how to detect stale responses, how to roll back).

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4501 by kelly - "php: cache scope change and migration guide (WIP)" (automated).

nina: Thanks all. Owners: kelly -> docs + banner; rahul -> SDK option + CI; oscar -> comms + customer list. Ping me for enterprise exceptions. :thumbsup:
